data.title: TriMas Packaging to Showcase Global Beauty Packaging Capabilities at Leading Trade Shows This Fall
data.description: TriMas Packaging, a division of TriMas Corporation (NASDAQ: TRS), is set to present its wide range of dispensing, closure, and bespoke packaging options tailored for the fragrance, beauty, and personal care sectors at two major industry showcases this autumn. The company will exhibit at LUXE PACK Monaco from September 28 to 30, 2026, located at the Grimaldi Forum in Monaco with a booth at RD16 in Ravel Hall. Following this, TriMas Packaging will also be at Beautyworld Dubai from October 6 to 8, 2026, held at the Dubai World Trade Centre.

data.title: Knightscope Unveils Its 250 Years of Freedom K7 Tribute Livery at GSX 2026
data.description: Knightscope, Inc. (NASDAQ: KSCP) showcased a unique tribute livery on the newly introduced K7 Autonomous Security Robot at GSX 2026 in Atlanta. The special design features the American flag and the inscription "250 YEARS OF FREEDOM" to commemorate the semiquincentennial of U.S. independence from 1776 to 2026. The event took place at the Georgia World Congress Center and drew attention to the company's innovative Autonomous Security Force technology.

data.title: Producer Of Strategic Metal Soars 43% On Pentagon Deals
data.description: On Monday, the Elmet Group experienced a significant increase, surpassing a buy point, following a $450 million investment from the Pentagon. This investment aims to enhance the domestic production of tungsten. As a result, the company's stocks surged by 43%, marking a notable achievement for the strategic metal producer.

data.title: The Psychedelics News That Sent Definium, Already Up 190% This Year, Soaring
data.description: On Monday, Definium Therapeutics reported that their LSD treatment effectively alleviated symptoms of anxiety. Following this news, the company's shares experienced a surge once again. This development marks a significant milestone for Definium, as their stock had already risen by 190% earlier this year. The positive results of the psychedelic treatment are likely to further boost investor confidence in the company's innovative approach.

data.title: Bolt.new Launches Forge to Widen Who Gets to Build with AI, and to Train Open Models on What They Make
data.description: In San Francisco, Bolt.new, an AI app builder, introduced Bolt Forge, a research preview intending to broaden access to software development and promoting open-source models. Under the new initiative, every individual subscribed to the Bolt.new Pro plan will receive 50 times more usage on open models at no additional charge. Price barriers have historically restricted AI building opportunities, deterring individuals with ideas and skills from pursuing software development. With Forge, AI building becomes more accessible.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops New Card and Dice Combination Game (CHK-6005)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 14, 2026, an inventor from Markham, IL shared his motivation behind creating a new game called Roll@Risk. The game combines cards, dice, and chips to offer an interactive experience devoid of electronic devices and video screens. The inventor expressed a desire to introduce an entertaining option for players, and his creation presents a point-building system designed to enhance gameplay.

data.title: WallachBeth Capital Announces Closing of Tenon Medical Warrant Inducement Offering for Aggregate Gross Proceeds of Approximately $2,872,338
data.description: On September 14, 2026, in Jersey City, New Jersey, WallachBeth Capital LLC revealed that Tenon Medical, Inc. (NASDAQ: TNON), a medical device firm aiming to revolutionize healthcare, is the focus of their announcement. WallachBeth Capital LLC is known for offering capital markets and institutional execution solutions.

data.title: Thomson Reuters Named a Leader in IDC MarketScape for Compliant e-Invoicing
data.description: Thomson Reuters has achieved a significant accomplishment by being recognized as a Leader in four categories by IDC MarketScape - value-added tax, sales and use tax, global trade, and e-invoicing. This places them as the sole provider with this distinction. The announcement was made on September 14, 2026, in Toronto. Thomson Reuters, a globally prominent content and technology firm, saw its stocks rise on both the TSX and Nasdaq exchanges under the ticker symbol TRI on the same day.

data.title: Applied Invest Announces Strategic Investment in Integrated Power
data.description: Applied Invest has disclosed their strategic investment in Integrated Power Co. and J.A. Wever Construction, collectively known as Integrated Power, based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. Integrated Power is a top provider of electrical infrastructure services, specializing in constructing, maintaining, and offering related services for vital components of the electric grid such as substations, transmission lines, and power generation facilities. This move aims to capitalize on the expertise of Integrated Power's workforce and their integrated approach to electrical and foundation work.

data.title: UTEM Welcomes Kim Zander as Chief Executive Officer
data.description: In Hewitt, Texas, on September 14, 2026, UTEM, a company specializing in manufacturing aerial lift trucks, revealed that Kim Zander has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer. Zander, known for her experience in organizational management, is set to lead the company into its future endeavors.

data.title: GAC Commercial Vehicle Accelerates Global Expansion with IAA TRANSPORTATION 2026 Debut
data.description: In Hanover, Germany on September 14, 2026, GAC Commercial Vehicle made their debut at IAA TRANSPORTATION 2026 with the theme "Delivering the Future Together." The event featured displays of products, technologies, and open-ecosystem advancements in their new-energy heavy and light commercial vehicles.

data.title: The Cooper Companies (NASDAQ: COO) Scrutinized Over U.S. Channel Inventory Reductions Driving Stock Sharply Lower -- HBSS
data.description: On September 14, 2026, shareholders of The Cooper Companies, Inc. (NASDAQ: COO) experienced a significant decline in share value as prices dropped by $9.31, marking a 14.6% decrease following the company's release of its Q3 2026 financial report. The results disclosed details regarding the company's actions to reduce U.S. channel inventory levels, impacting investor confidence and leading to the drop in share prices.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Modified Steering Wheel System for Vehicles (CHK-5031)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 14, 2026, an inventor from St. Louis, Missouri shared their inspiration for creating the DOUBLE, a device that enables driving from the passenger seat. The inventor, who underwent knee surgery and was unable to drive for six weeks due to limited mobility in the right leg, identified a need for this innovative solution. This invention aims to provide an alternative for individuals facing similar mobility challenges. The DOUBLE offers a potential solution for those who require assistance in driving due to physical limitations, showcasing the inventiveness and adaptability of individuals in overcoming obstacles.

data.title: Bitmine acquires $68M ETH, nearing 6M total. Aim is 5% of supply ownership with majority earning staking rewards.
data.description: The recent acquisition moves the company closer to its target of possessing 5% of the total Ethereum supply, and a majority of these tokens are eligible for staking rewards.

data.title: Prime IV Hydration & Wellness Expands Personalized Wellness Offerings with BHRT and Niagen®
data.description: In Colorado Springs on September 14, 2026, Prime IV Hydration & Wellness announced an expansion of their services to cater to clients seeking flexible and personalized support in managing their physical and mental well-being as they age. As the top IV therapy franchise in the country, they are now offering a wider range of advanced wellness options to meet the growing demand. This expansion is set to provide clients with more ways to address their feelings, functionality, and overall aging process.
